system.description:
If the target's HP is equal to or less than your [[POW Mod] x 3], it becomes [Incapacitated] or [Dead] (your choice). If the target could not be made [Incapacitated] or [Dead] through this skill, then the [Hate] cost of this skill is 0.

(Target: Mob): Regardless of HP, the target becomes [Incapacitated] or [Dead] (your choice).

A special skill that sneaks up with the minimum necessary movement and stabs the finish. Neutralize dying opponents and lower-ranked enemies.
